title: Paper SNDK filled; one book abstained and another evaluation failed

Paper SNDK filled; one book abstained and another evaluation failed

Paper trading · 2026-11-23T17:00:15.912275-05:00

The cutoff is 2026-11-23 22:00:15.912Z (5:00 p.m. EST). The paper account has a broker-reported SNDK fill and a later holding snapshot. The paper performance snapshot at 20:15:41Z predates the fill. Book prices are recorded snapshots: MU's midpoint was observed at 21:00:00Z (4:00 p.m. EST), and book gains exclude fees. These records are not a guaranteed closing-price feed; older snapshots may precede fills. The mean-reversion book completed a NO_ACTION evaluation due to unavailable evidence. The short-horizon book evaluation failed, so it has no completed decision to report.

Today's lesson: Follow the trade from proposal to fill

A proposal, approval, and fill are separate events. Here, the paper account proposed a $50 SNDK buy, deterministic risk approved it, and the submitted order later filled: 0.567601 shares at $88.088, about $50 before any unreported commission. The mean-reversion book made no proposal, while the short-horizon evaluation failed. Neither book outcome is a fill.

Portfolio review

Paper account

Paper account: the latest account snapshot, at 2026-11-23 22:00:15.665Z (5:00 p.m. EST), records $1,950 cash and $2,000.38 equity. It includes the SNDK holding described below. The paper performance snapshot at 20:15:41Z recorded $2,000 equity and zero P/L, but it predates the order and fill, so it does not report the completed trade's result. The day's paper proposal was to buy $50 of SNDK with a limit ceiling of $88.09. Deterministic risk approved it. The order was submitted at 20:19:31Z and marked FILLED; the broker fill record reports 0.567601 shares at $88.088 at 20:50:00Z. No separate simulated book fill is reported. The holding snapshot at 22:00:15Z records price $88.7001 and unrealized P/L +$0.347428; it is a recorded after-hours snapshot, not a guaranteed live or closing price. The strongest recorded counterargument was that SNDK's unusually high sampled margins could fall sharply amid NAND pricing and regulatory risks, with truncated disclosures and older debt information adding uncertainty.

Every holding

SNDK — Paper account

Paper account: 0.567601 SNDK shares at an average purchase price of $88.088. The broker fill record shows a buy at $88.088; the order was marked FILLED. At the holding snapshot, 2026-11-23 22:00:15.665Z (5:00 p.m. EST), the recorded price was $88.7001, market value $50.346265, and unrealized P/L +$0.347428. This is a recorded after-hours snapshot, not a guaranteed live or closing quote. The recorded thesis argued that the market might be discounting SNDK's cash generation too heavily: it compared $17.365 billion in operating cash flow after physical PP&E purchases with a $12.534 billion market capitalization. Its strongest counterargument was that unusually high sampled profitability may not last: historical operating margins included losses, while NAND pricing and regulatory concerns, truncated disclosures, and older debt data left uncertainty. The fill commission is null, so it is unknown.

Mean-reversion book: 0.053191 MU shares at an average purchase price of $939.88. The cutoff holding record gives a market value of $37.54433544 and unrealized P/L of -$12.44882164. Its observed price was $705.84, the bid/ask midpoint recorded at 2026-11-23 21:00:00Z (4:00 p.m. EST); this is a last-session observation, not a live price. For example, 0.053191 shares at that midpoint are worth about $37.54. The book valuation says purchase basis and gains exclude fees. No current MU thesis or original purchase reasoning is supplied; the book decision says its recognition window and invalidation conditions are unavailable. The strongest recorded case for continued investigation is MU's reported earnings and cash generation. Against that, unusually high profitability, deteriorating completed-session relative performance, and missing long-term debt data make the picture incomplete. The unrealized loss alone does not establish that the original case has failed.

Snapshots and fills have different times

The paper holding snapshot at 22:00:15Z records SNDK at $88.7001, while the broker fill was at $88.088 earlier at 20:50Z. The former is a later recorded snapshot and the latter is the execution price; they answer different questions. The book's MU value uses its 21:00Z observed midpoint. Neither snapshot should be described as a live quote.

What to watch next

The mean-reversion book recorded a reconsideration time of 2026-11-24 20:15Z, tied to readable SNDK disclosures and MU's original investment case; that time does not mean the evidence has arrived. The paper thesis lists the next quarterly financial release and issuer pricing and regulatory updates as things to monitor. Their outcomes remain unknown.

Proposal: A suggested trade. It still needs risk approval and an execution before it becomes a fill.

Deterministic risk: A rule-based check that approves or rejects a proposal. Approval alone does not mean an order filled.

Unrealized P/L: The recorded change in a holding's value compared with its purchase basis, before the holding is sold.

Bid/ask midpoint: The average of the recorded bid and ask used for a book valuation; it is a snapshot, not necessarily a live price.

Data timing and limitations

Prices come from recorded snapshots, not a guaranteed closing-price feed.
Paper account holdings use the latest recorded snapshot, which may precede fills.
Book marks use observed bid/ask midpoints at price_as_of, not guaranteed live prices. Without an admitted quote the value remains unknown; book gains exclude fees.
Work starting after the cutoff is outside this report. Failures remain labelled.
